items.title: Unpushed branch validate-media-recipes holds an unmerged schema axis + 11,088-record backfill
items.body:
## Summary

`validate-media-recipes` is a **local-only branch, never pushed**, last touched 2026-06-29. It carries six commits of real work that is not on `main` by any route:

```
7a2ff6f  Backfill composition_type across corpus (11,088 records)
87af185  Standardize media-type vocabulary as orthogonal axes
cdca81c  Root R2A family: parent R3 A under canonical R2A
6e5ee61  Curate Half Strength R2A: re-parent to R2A, document pyruvate exception
f7c171c  Curate R2A variant family: re-parent 1/10 R2A, fix fold-change + labels
6af6583  Add media recipe-validation deep-research flow (native + Edison)
```

Confirmed unmerged, not merged-by-another-route: `composition_type` appears **nowhere** in `main`'s schema or corpus.

Beyond the corpus it touches `src/culturemech/schema/culturemech.yaml` (+113/−9), `scripts/migrate_medium_type_axes.py`, `scripts/render_media_prompt.py`, `scripts/research_media.py`, `templates/media_recipe_validation.md` and the `deep-research-medium` skill.

## Why it can't simply be PR'd as-is

A month of `main` has landed since its merge-base (#105–#143). A direct merge reports **~1,504 conflicting paths**, almost all of them in the 11,088 backfilled records — which have since been touched by the archaeal recategorizations (#115/#120/#137/#143), the solution-record work (#124) and the id↔label passes.

## Suggested approach

Do **not** merge the 11,088 record edits. They are *derived* output — `migrate_medium_type_axes.py` produced them. Instead:

1. PR the **source** changes alone: schema, migration script, templates, skill. Small and reviewable.
2. Re-run the migration against current `main` to regenerate the backfill, so it reflects today's corpus rather than June's.
3. Land the three R2A curation commits separately — they are hand-curation, not derived, and are the part a rebase would genuinely lose.

That converts a 1,504-conflict merge into a small review plus a deterministic regeneration.

## Note

This branch has never been pushed, so it exists only on one machine and is one `git branch -D` away from being lost. Filing this so the work is at least recorded. It was not touched, pushed, or deleted while surveying branches — whether to revive it is the author's call.

Found while auditing branches for unmerged work.

items.title: Recover validate-media-recipes: orthogonal media-type axes + 11,088-record backfill (closes #146)
items.body:
## What this is

The `validate-media-recipes` branch, recovered. It was local-only and never
pushed (#146) — six commits dating to 2026-06-29, carrying a schema change, a
migration, three hand-curation commits, and a deep-research flow.

It is now pushed and merged up to current `main`.

## The blocker in #146 was a miscount

#146 said a direct merge "reports **~1,504 conflicting paths**" and concluded the
11,088 record edits should be thrown away and regenerated. That number is the
count of paths **touched by both sides**, not the count of conflicts:

```
files modified by both branch and main       1502
files branch modified that main deleted         0
actual conflicts (git merge-tree)               0
```

The merge is clean. Each record edit adds a single `composition_type:` line;
main's recategorizations (#115/#120/#137/#143), solution work (#124) and
id↔label passes edited other lines. Nothing overlaps textually, and no record
the branch touched was deleted or renamed out from under it.

So the backfill did not need regenerating — but it was checked anyway.

## Staleness check: the backfill is still correct

`migrate_medium_type_axes.py` is idempotent by construction (it writes an axis
slot only when absent, never touches `medium_type`). Re-run against the *merged*
corpus:

```
Scanned: 15878
medium_type present: 11094 | missing: 4784
Would apply (dry-run) axis backfill to 0 record(s).
```

Zero. Every record `main` has added since June either already carries the axis
slots or has no `medium_type` to derive them from. June's output is identical to
what today's corpus would produce.

## The schema change

`medium_type` conflated three orthogonal properties in one single-valued slot.
It is now deprecated (not removed — still readable, no longer required) and
split into three axes:

| axis | slot | cardinality |
|---|---|---|
| how chemically defined | `composition_type` | single |
| how nutrient-rich | `nutritional_class` | single |
| what it is designed to do | `functional_role` | multivalued |

Only the deterministic mappings were backfilled — `DEFINED`→`DEFINED`,
`COMPLEX`→`UNDEFINED`, `MINIMAL`→`nutritional_class`, and the three functional
values. `RICH` vs `GENERAL_PURPOSE` cannot be inferred from `medium_type` and is
left to curators. `BUFFER` and `NEGATIVE_CONTROL` are deliberately unmapped —
they are not growth media.

## Also in here

Three R2A curation commits (hand work, not derived): roots the R2A family under
a canonical parent, re-parents 1/10 and Half-Strength R2A, fixes a fold-change
error and labels, and documents the pyruvate exception. Plus the
`media_recipe_validation` deep-research flow and its template.

## Test plan

- [x] Merge verified conflict-free with `git merge-tree` before merging
- [x] Migration re-run against merged corpus: 0 records drift
- [x] `just validate-strict`: 15,878 files scanned, **0 ERROR rows**
- [x] Suite: **520 passed, 2 skipped** — same as main's baseline
- [x] Derived-artifact guards from #147/#133 (id registry, recipe indexes) pass

Closes #146.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

---

## Review

Reviewed across four dimensions (schema, migration script, corpus data, tooling).
Six findings; three are fixed in this PR, three are filed for later because they
are curation work rather than code.

**Fixed here**

- **#149 — the generated dataclasses were stale, and that broke every backfilled
  record.** `culturemech_dataclasses.py` is generated by pythongen and nothing
  regenerated or checked it, so `MediaRecipe(**record)` raised
  `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'composition_type'` on all 11,088.
  `linkml-validate` reads the *schema*, so validate-strict passed on all 15,878
  files while the API was broken. Regenerated, added `just gen-dataclasses`, and
  added a drift guard — verified it bites by running it against the pre-fix file
  (4 of its 5 tests fail).
- **#153 — the migration had no tests and an undeclared dependency.** 22 tests
  added. `ruamel` was present only transitively; had that edge dropped, the bare
  `except ImportError` would have routed every write through `pyyaml.safe_dump`
  (a 37-line diff on a 164-line record where ruamel produces 1). Now declared,
  and `write_yaml` refuses rather than reflowing.
- **#155 — a justfile recipe pinned `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13`**, so it ran
  only on the machine it was written on. Now `uv run python`.

**Filed, not fixed**

- **#152 — two of the three new axes ship empty.** `composition_type` covers
  11,092 records; `nutritional_class` and `functional_role` cover **one each**.
  The corpus only ever held `COMPLEX` and `DEFINED`, so the migration's mappings
  for `MINIMAL`/`SELECTIVE`/`DIFFERENTIAL`/`ENRICHMENT` never fired. Filling them
  needs signal the old slot never carried — curation, not another mechanical pass.
- **#154 — `TaxonomyClassifier` still branches on `medium_type`**, using four
  values that appear on zero records. Low impact: 7% coverage, no call site
  outside the module.
- **#158 — 284 `DEFINED` records (11.5%) list chemically undefined ingredients**
  (peptone, yeast extract, meat extract). Not introduced here: the migration
  mapped `medium_type: DEFINED` faithfully, so the error was already in the old
  slot; the new slot's precise definition is what makes it detectable. 3,116
  `UNDEFINED` records are `SEMI_DEFINED` candidates.
- **#156 — 12 more `justfile` recipes pin `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13`**, all
  pre-existing. `project.justfile` uses `uv run` throughout; `justfile` does not.
- **#157 — `reports/chebi_consistency.tsv` is tracked but never checked, and is
  stale on `main`.** The fourth instance of #145, and the last one still open.
  Not fixed here: regenerating it would put unrelated corpus drift in this diff.

**Checked and clean**

- **This backfill is not an instance of #141.** The bulk pass ran `--text`,
  which splices lines in without a YAML writer: `+1/-0` on all 11,081 files.
- No code depended on `medium_type` being required.

## Test plan (updated)

- [x] Merge verified conflict-free with `git merge-tree` before merging
- [x] Migration re-run against merged corpus: 0 records drift
- [x] `just validate-strict`: 15,878 files scanned, **0 ERROR rows**
- [x] `just check-chebi-grounding` passes locally
- [x] Suite: **547 passed, 2 skipped** (520 baseline + 5 dataclass guard + 22 migration)
- [x] Derived-artifact guards from #147/#133 (id registry, recipe indexes) pass
- [x] Both new guards mutation-tested against the real pre-fix state

items.title: Schema/pipeline audit (data): bulk YAML migrations
items.body:
## Summary

**Mechanical bulk-data half** of the schema/instance/pipeline audit. Applies the migrations driven by the scripts in #15. Base branch is `audit-code` so the schema changes the migrated YAMLs depend on are in scope.

7,978 files changed (~7,800 YAML records + the regenerated validation TSV).

## Migrations applied

| Migration | Entries | Script |
|---|---:|---|
| `curation_history[*].date` → `timestamp` (ISO + UTC) | 8,688 | `migrate_legacy_fields.py` |
| `preparation_steps[*].instruction` → `action` + `description` | 846 | `migrate_preparation_steps.py` |
| `references[*].reference_id` → `reference` | 497 | `migrate_legacy_fields.py` |
| `category` UPPER → lowercase | 675 | `migrate_legacy_fields.py` |
| `concentration.unit` UG_PER_L → MICROG_PER_L | 437 | `migrate_legacy_fields.py` |
| `concentration.unit` PERCENT → PERCENT_W_V | 12 | `migrate_legacy_fields.py` |
| `concentration.unit` G_PER_100ML → G_PER_L (×10) | 6 | `cleanup_residual_errors.py` |
| `concentration.unit` ML_PER_40ML → PERCENT_V_V (×2.5) | 2 | `cleanup_residual_errors.py` |
| `data_quality_flags` dict → list | 273 | `migrate_data_quality_flags.py` |
| Doubly-wrapped `synonym_text` flattened | 22 | `cleanup_residual_errors.py` |
| Missing `concentration` → VARIABLE placeholder | 47 | `cleanup_residual_errors.py` |
| Missing `explanation` → generic placeholder | 3 | `cleanup_residual_errors.py` |

## Provenance

Every migrated record carries a `CurationEvent` entry documenting which migrations fired. Examples of `action` values used:
- `MIGRATED_LEGACY_FIELDS`
- `MIGRATED_PREPARATION_STEPS`
- `MIGRATED_DATA_QUALITY_FLAGS`
- `CLEANUP_RESIDUAL_ERRORS`

Re-runs of any migration script are no-ops.

## Reviewer guidance

Per-file review is impractical at 7,800 files. Validation is the unit of trust: the CI gate added in #15 runs `just validate-strict` against the full corpus on every PR and will fail loudly if any migration introduced drift.

- **What to spot-check:** open 3-4 representative YAMLs (e.g. `data/normalized_yaml/algae/2asw.yaml`, `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/mediadive_1448_Main_sol_697.yaml`, `data/normalized_yaml/specialized/Half_strength_Murashige_Skoog_medium_for_Arabidopsis_growth.yaml`) and confirm the curation_history entries look sensible.
- **What CI will verify:** full-corpus `just validate-strict` returns 0 ERROR rows.
- **What the migration scripts can replay if needed:** every change here is reproducible from #15's scripts alone — this PR is the cached output.

## Merge order

1. Merge #15 (code).
2. Rebase this PR onto `main` (button on GitHub once #15 is merged) and merge.

items.title: Backfill source_environment from CommunityMech ENVO data (closes #2)
items.body:
## Summary
Issue #2 added the `SourceEnvironmentDescriptor` schema + `source_environment` slot (commit `dbe26e8ce`) but no recipes populated it. This PR ships `scripts/backfill_source_environment.py` and applies it: 17 recipes get 22 ENVO-grounded environment entries pulled directly from CommunityMech's curated `environment_term` data.

## Method
The script walks `../CommunityMech` (excluding `tests/` and `examples/`) for community YAMLs that carry **both** `environment_term` (ENVO-grounded) and a `culturemech_id` back-reference. Each such pair is a curator-vetted assertion that the linked recipe targets that environment, so it's safe to populate `source_environment` directly. Dedup is by `(recipe_id, envo_id)`; some recipes are touched by multiple communities at different environments (e.g., `CultureMech:000423` gets 4 entries: anaerobic digester / soil / acid mine drainage / sulfate-free anaerobic).

Each touched recipe carries a `CurationEvent` via `record_curation_event()` for provenance. Script is idempotent — re-runs add nothing because the dedup guard catches existing entries.

## Out of scope
Inferring `source_environment` for the remaining 15,810 recipes from recipe metadata (names, applications, descriptions) is an NLP/keyword-mining enrichment problem — separate future work.

## Validation
`just validate-strict`: **0 ERROR rows across 15,827 records** (unchanged).

## Test plan
- [x] Dry-run reports 17 recipes / 22 env entries to add
- [x] Apply produces matching numbers
- [x] Re-run after apply touches 0 recipes (idempotent)
- [x] `just validate-strict` clean
- [x] Sample record shows correctly structured `source_environment:` list

Closes #2.
